description: HTML source code for the Database Viewer web interface, including styles, layout, and embedded JavaScript for fetching and displaying database information and table data

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases and populates the sidebar

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets current selections

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing database items and loading tables

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables within a selected database

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from selected table

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders data in a tabular format in the UI

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Converts data values into appropriate table cell HTML, handling long text and objects

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell contents for long text or objects
